Government of India
Directorate General of Health Services
Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi
(New Drugs Division)
FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road,
New Delhi,
Date:’.. 4 .
To
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sub: Prescribing Information Leaflet change for “Docetaxel” marketed in the
country- Reg.
Sir,
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (NCC-
PvPI), functioning at IPC, Ghaziabad has forwarded their recommendation based on
ADR reports on Docetaxel which was discussed by them in the 9" Signal Review
Panel (SRP) under the programme meeting held on 29'" Nov, 2016 with an objective
to detect Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet change from Indian database and
promote patient safety.
In the meeting, PvPI has evaluated the reported ADRs for Docetaxel on the basis of
Individual Case Study Reports (ICSRs) and recommended CDSCO to take
necessary steps to incorporate Candidiasis as an adverse event in the Prescribing
Information Leaflet (PIL) of Docetaxel marketed in the country.
Subsequently, PvPI recommendations was deliberated in the Subject Expert
Committee (SEC-Oncology & Haematology) meeting held on 26.05.2022 at CDSCO
(HQ), New Delhi.

After detailed deliberation, the committee recommended that CDSCO should
request the State Drugs Controllers to direct the manufacturers of the drug to include
Docetaxel associated Candidiasis as an adverse event in the package insert of
the drug as suggested by PvPI.
The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office.
Accordingly, you are requested to direct the manufacturers of Docetaxel under your
jurisdiction to incorporate Docetaxel associated Candidiasis as an adverse event
in the package insert/promotional literature of the drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
Yours faithfully,
ee
Dr. V.G. Somani
Drugs Controller General (India)
1. Copy for information & follow-up:
All Zonal / Sub Zonal offices of CDSCO.
